name: show_object
description: Show, find or point at a planet, the Moon, a star, a constellation, a galaxy, nebula or star cluster in the sky.

name.description: e.g. Saturn, Orion, Betelgeuse, M31, Andromeda Galaxy, Pleiades

name: follow_object
description: Track or follow a moving object, keeping it centered on screen.

name: set_location
description: View the sky from a place on Earth: a city, country or landmark.

place.description: e.g. Tokyo, Sydney Australia, the South Pole

name: set_date_time
description: Show the sky at a date and time.

name: reset_to_now
description: Go back to the present moment, current time now.

name: set_time_speed
description: Speed up, slow down, pause or reverse the clock.

name: set_view
description: Change field of view to whole sky, naked eye, binoculars or telescope.

name: look_toward
description: Face a compass direction, or look straight up.

name: show_overlay
description: Turn on or show a display overlay: lines, names, labels, grid, horizon, atmosphere.

name: hide_overlay
description: Turn off, hide or remove a display overlay: lines, names, labels, grid, horizon, atmosphere.

name: show_path
description: Draw the path a planet or the Moon takes across the stars over some days.

name: object_info
description: Tell me about an object: what it is, how far away, how bright, how big.

name: rise_set_times
description: When does an object rise or set.

name: list_visible
description: List which planets, stars, constellations, galaxies, nebulae or clusters are up or visible now.
